title: Remove command diagnostics actions flat alias
summary: Removed the transitional flat window.commandHistoryDiagnosticsActions alias while preserving the canonical mediaPipelineCommandHistory.commandHistoryDiagnosticsActions namespace export. Updated launch-history reuse, browser smoke access, static guards, WebView export inventory, public contract baseline, and generated summaries.
reason: Continue opportunistic WebView flat-export cleanup in a touched command-history domain while keeping backend-owned command diagnostics behavior unchanged.
behavior_before: Command diagnostics actions were available through both window.mediaPipelineCommandHistory.commandHistoryDiagnosticsActions and the transitional window.commandHistoryDiagnosticsActions flat alias. Launch history used the flat helper when composing launch diagnostics actions.
behavior_after: Command diagnostics actions remain available through window.mediaPipelineCommandHistory.commandHistoryDiagnosticsActions only. Launch history and WebView smoke coverage now use the namespace helper, and static tests reject reintroducing the removed flat alias.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_local_api.py now asserts the command diagnostics actions helper is namespace-exported and not flat-exported.
tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_web_static.py now guards against the removed command diagnostics actions flat alias.
tests/webview/test_webview_command_evidence_smoke.py now exercises command diagnostics actions through mediaPipelineCommandHistory.
manual_validation: rg "window\.commandHistoryDiagnosticsActions =" apps\desktop\webview\static\assets tests Docs -n (OK; only negative test assertions remain)
rollback_plan: Reintroduce window.commandHistoryDiagnosticsActions in commandHistory.js, switch launchHistoryView.js and the WebView smoke back to the flat helper, restore the previous WebView inventory/counts and generated public contract baseline, refresh summaries, and rerun the same WebView validation ladder.
